enriched_activities.desc: Lies down on bed. Pulls blanket over body. Closes eyes. Sleeps. Turns to side. Adjusts pillow. Continues sleeping. Breathes deeply. Moves arm. Turns over. Sleeps. Remains asleep.

Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Urinates. Flushes toilet. Turns on tap. Washes hands. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Turns off tap. Dries hands. Puts on clothes. Turns off light. Walks out of bathroom.

Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out milk. Closes refrigerator. Opens cabinet. Takes out bowl. Takes out cereal box. Pours cereal into bowl. Pours milk into bowl. Puts milk back in refrigerator. Takes spoon from drawer. Eats cereal. Drinks milk from bowl. Rinses bowl. Places bowl in sink. Opens dishwasher. Loads bowl. Closes dishwasher. Wipes counter with cloth.

Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Board bus. Pays fare. Finds seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Reads phone. Checks messages. Puts phone in pocket. Stands up. Pulls cord. Exits bus. Walks to workplace. Enters building. Greets colleague. Walks to locker room. Changes into scrubs. Puts on ID badge. Walks to station.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Arrives at station. Reviews patient charts. Washes hands. Enters patient room. Greets patient. Checks vital signs. Measures blood pressure. Administers medication. Updates records. Consults with doctor. Assists with procedure. Washes hands. Takes lunch break. Eats sandwich. Returns to station. Responds to call light. Assists patient to bathroom. Documents care. Attends staff meeting. Ends shift.

Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Board bus. Pays fare. Finds seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Listens to music. Checks phone. Puts phone away. Stands up. Pulls cord. Exits bus. Walks home. Enters house. Removes shoes. Hangs coat. Walks to kitchen.

Opens refrigerator. Takes out vegetables. Closes refrigerator. Takes out cutting board. Takes out knife. Washes vegetables. Cuts vegetables. Turns on stove. Places pan on stove. Adds vegetables. Stirs with spatula. Turns off stove. Takes plate. Serves food. Sits at table. Eats dinner. Clears table. Loads dishwasher.

Walks to living room. Sits on sofa. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Changes channel. Watches news. Checks phone. Watches show. Stands up. Goes to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out water. Closes refrigerator. Returns to sofa. Sits down. Drinks water. Watches TV. Turns off TV.

Sits at desk. Opens laptop. Turns on computer. Enters password. Opens email. Reads emails. Replies to email. Opens browser. Searches for information. Reads article. Opens document. Types report. Saves document. Closes document. Opens game. Plays game. Closes game. Shuts down computer. Closes laptop. Stands up.

Walks to bedroom. Turns on light. Lies on bed. Picks up book. Opens book. Reads page. Turns page. Continues reading. Closes book. Puts book on nightstand. Turns off light. Adjusts pillow. Lies back. Closes eyes. Turns to side. Pulls blanket.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Uses toilet. Flushes toilet. Turns on tap. Washes hands. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Turns off tap. Dries face. Applies moisturizer. Takes off clothes. Puts on pajamas. Turns off light. Walks to bedroom.
Lies down on bed. Pulls blanket over body. Closes eyes. Sleeps. Turns to side. Adjusts pillow. Continues sleeping. Breathes deeply. Moves arm. Turns over. Sleeps. Remains asleep.
